status: Proposal pending the owner's approval. The planner takes ideas in priority order (2 POV stories a week); pin an idea to a week with "week": "2026-W50".
rules: Binding: docs/PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md and CLAUDE.md. Zoo (title case, never "ZOO") hosts; Badger is nonverbal: no lines, no captions, no synthesized dog sounds.
No income or return claims, no price predictions, no buy calls. Every fictional market example uses synthetic data, labelled illustrative.
No names, handles, likenesses or voices of private individuals (the repo is public). Real organisations appear only in attributed, sourced facts.
Every factual sentence carries [src:id] with a verified source, or a fact-bank [fact:id]; research.md holds the binding "Must not say" list the claim gate reads.
Synthetic demo data only: no real wallets, handles, messages, contract addresses, referral links or QR codes.
No third-party logos or app UI (Pump.fun, Solana, Telegram, exchanges, AI labs) without checking their brand rules; invented brands for fictional products.
Made for kids: No. Altered or synthetic content: No (clearly animated, generic synthetic voice). Paid promotion: none planned; any offer later needs the disclosure said and shown (FTC 16 CFR 255).
Any video that promotes the AAI coin needs legal review first (none is planned here).
